item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan looking at a lamp flame through holes in three cardboard sheets X, Y and Z.

In which case can he see the flame?

options.A: The three holes lie on one straight line at the same height.
options.B: The hole in Y is moved well above the other two holes.
options.C: Light from the flame bends freely around the sheets, so hole alignment does not matter.
options.D: He makes the lamp brighter, so he can see through any arrangement of the holes.
